name: Spot
summary: Take-aim and report the precise location of a foe or other feature of the Sea.
effects: Roll 2d6 plus the Tier of the Card spent against the Tier of an unspotted Target. You Spot the Target on a Success.

attrs.Critical Effect: Your next Attack against the Target is easier by 1.

name: Shoot
summary: The essence of war, the principle of Attack.
effects:
Choose a Weapon, spend Manpower, and roll 2d6 plus its Accuracy against the Target's Tier. Success inflicts the Damage on the Target.
The Cooldown of this Action is tied to the Weapon used, which must be satisfied before any Weapons can be used to Attack again.
Additionally, the same Weapon cannot be Shot more than once in the same Round.

attrs.Range Limits: If the Target is outside the Weapon's Range, this Test is rolled with Banes equal to the distance in Hexes.

name: Player Name
summary: Action/Potence:
effects:
Pick two Traits, qualifying with you Skills and Disciplines.
Once per Combat, you may exchange this Trait for another qualified for.
Once per Combat, you may change an Attack to a Critical Success.
Once per Combat, you may prevent a Casualty.
Once per Combat, you may remove a Notch from your Ship.
Once per Combat, you may Move for free.
Once per Combat, you can break all lines-of-sight on your Ship.
Once per Combat, you can change Spot Test to a Critical Success.
Once per Combat, you can increase your Ship's Manpower by thrice the Tier of any one Crew Card for that Round.
You can perceive any supernatural phenomena in your surroundings, unless concealed by an effect with a Tier exceeding your Arcane.
When Patching it Up, you can make an Artifice Test, DC_12+(Ship Tier) to remove one Notch. Critical Success removes 2.
When Rammed, you can increase Ship Hardness by twice your Span.
If you Shoot a Ship Weapon, and its Cooldown is less than or equal to your Cascade, you can Shoot it once more for free, inflicting 10 less Damage.
When Ramming, you can add twice your Crush to the Damage dealt to the Target.)
You can add your Sharpshooting to Damage dealt with Ship Weapons.
When Spotting, you can add half your Scouting.
When Attacking a Ship that has not Spotted yours, add your Skullduggery to the Attack.
Once per Combat, you can perform any Ship Action as a Reaction to anything.
Your Ship's Manpower is increased by your Leadership.
